items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was similar to, well, not in the same style, but in the same tradition of Art Tatum, Teddy Wilson, and maybe James P Johnson, even further back.

ctx.x: He played with two hands and he was very effective. He was similar to, well, not in the same style, but in the same tradition of Art Tatum, Teddy Wilson, and maybe James P Johnson, even further back. Who knows, maybe even Scott Joplin even further than that. That gets into a different thing though.
